name: Project Integration Management
excerpt: Project Integration Management involves coordinating all elements of a project to ensure successful completion.
notes:
- Project Integration Management is a key aspect of project management that focuses on ensuring that all elements of a project are properly coordinated.
- It involves making trade-offs among competing objectives and alternatives to meet or exceed stakeholder needs and expectations.
- This concept is central to the overall success of a project as it ensures that all processes and activities are aligned towards the project goals.

- Project Integration Management ensures that various project elements are effectively coordinated to achieve project objectives.
- It involves making trade-offs among competing objectives and alternatives to meet or exceed stakeholder needs and expectations.
